title: Ruby Golem
description: Transforms your golem into a ruby one.
body:
**_The resource pack replaces the usual golem with a ruby ​​one!_**

**ツ Preview ツ**

[♥ The Iron Golems send their greetings! ♥]![:)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e220192fa69dfad5b7ae0a7b08a225c335a49ffd.jpeg)

**✦ Description ✦**

>  Transforms your golem into a ruby one!


**✿ Requirements ✿**

> The mod does not require any modifications at all and works in vanilla Minecraft.

- > **❌ ATTENTION ❌** 
- > DO NOT combine this resource pack with other resource packs changing the golem model , this can lead to visual (and not only) bugs, before using another resource pack on the Iron Golem, make sure that this resource pack is disabled (in the settings)!


**✔ Versions ✔**
> Resourcepack works on versions from 1.16.5 to 1.21.8
- > As for other versions - there may be bugs, you can report them to this email address (feedback) - **kaktusvochkah@gmail.com**

**♛ Installation Guide ♛**
> 1. Download the file of the version you need
> 2. WITHOUT unzipping, move the file to the "Resourcepacks" folder
> 3. Enable resource pack
> 4. Done, you can safely enjoy yourself!

**☏ Feedback contacts ☏**
> You can report bugs and suggest ideas by e-mail **kaktusvochkah@gmail.com**
